n on your own local agent — Cursor, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, or any file‑capable coding agent.**
English · 简体中文 · Changelog
This repo brings claude.ai's **Artifact types** to local agents: editable slide decks, design canvas
es, design systems, data dashboards and motion films, each opened in its own editor that runs on you
r machine. `motion-director` directs those films, from the point of the film to the finished cut. `d
ataviz` is the chart guide the agent reads before it draws any chart, in these skills or anywhere el
se. The five editors also ship as DeepSeek Harness plugins, installed from npm by name.
The original `baoyu-design` skill (self‑contained HTML mockups and prototypes) has been archived to
`archive/baoyu-design/`.
No website, no separate subscription, no upload step. The agent already on your machine does the wor
k, and every artifact stays in your repo.
## Skills in this repo
| Skill | Makes | You edit it in |
| `claude-slides` | Slide decks: `project/deck.json` plus one HTML file per slide | The slides edito

r: present, retype, drag; export PDF, HTML or PowerPoint |
| `claude-design` | A canvas of artboards
: `project/canvas.json` plus `.dc.html` Design Components | The canvas editor: artboards side by sid

e, play prototypes, retype copy, adjust tweaks; export HTML, PDF or PNG |
| `claude-design-system` |
Design systems: tokens, a README brand book, component previews, fonts, asset groups | The design s

ystem editor: browse and edit colors, type, components and assets |
| `claude-dashboard` | Data‑back
ed dashboards: datasets (CSV, TSV, JSON) and a page of charts, numbers and tables over them | The da

shboard page: live charts, filters, and a Sources panel that traces every number to its rows |
| `cl
aude-motion` | Motion films: animated videos, 10–30 s unless you ask for more and 15 minutes at most
, written as code scene by scene into the film's own store under `<root>/db/` | The Motion player: w

atch it fill in, retype lines, drag scene lengths, adjust style and tweaks; export MP4 or GIF |
| `m
otion-director` | A finished film with something to say: it finds the point, writes the narration fo
r the ear, has it voiced, times every scene to the words, and checks the frames as a viewer would. N

eeds `claude-motion` beside it | The same Motion player, open from the first minute |
| `dataviz` |
Better charts in any medium (HTML, SVG, d3, matplotlib, plotly…): picking the form, colors that stay
readable in light and dark and for color‑blind readers, marks, legends and tooltips, with a palette
validator script | Nothing to open: the agent reads it before writing chart code; swap `palette.md`
for your brand's colors |
## Artifact skills: editable decks, canvases, design systems, dashboards and films
These five skills write the Artifact type's own file format into a folder and open it in that type's
editor page, served from your machine. The agent writes the files and the editor shows each write a
t once; your edits in the editor are saved back into the same files, so you and the agent can take t
e; your edits in the editor are saved back into the same files, so you and the agent can take turns.
In the slides, canvas and design-system editors and on the dashboard page, choose **Comment** (or pr
ess **C**) to comment on an element or area; in the Motion player, its **Comment** button comments o
n a moment of the film. Comments stay in the project's local `comments.json`; the agent reads and re
plies through `artifact.mjs`. While it listens with `comments <root> --wait`, the editor offers **Se
nd to Agent** to send your comment for it to act on.
[该节后续省略]
### `claude-slides`: slide decks
A deck is `project/deck.json` plus one HTML file per slide. In the editor you can present full scree
n, retype any text, drag elements, add text, images, tables and shapes, and export to PDF, HTML or P
owerPoint. *Above: a five‑slide health class deck about sleep, built on a sample design system.*

## Why run it locally
- **Free yourself from the website.** You get the vast majority of `claude.ai/design`'s capabilities

without ever leaving your editor — same methodology, same craft standards, same output format.
- **
Best with Opus 5.5.** The skill is a long, demanding design brief; the stronger the model, the bette
r the result. Pair it with **Claude Opus 5.5** for the best output, and it still works well on other

capable models.
- **Edit side by side with the agent.** Each editor runs on `localhost`; your edits

save back into the same files the agent writes, so you can take turns.
- **Work together, no cloud.
** Share an editor on your local network with a link per role; others edit, comment or watch, and yo

u decide who stays in. Version history shows who changed what and brings any version back.
- **Every
thing is yours.** Output lands in `designs/<slug>/` as plain files you can version, fork, export, or
is yours.** Output lands in `designs/<slug>/` as plain files you can version, fork, export, or ship.
### Prerequisites
- A local agent — **Cursor**, **Claude Code**, **Codex**, or any of the 70+ agents the installer sup
ports (Cline, Roo Code, GitHub Copilot…). Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex have first‑class tool refer

ences inside the skill.
- **Claude Opus 5.5** selected as the model, for best results.
- **Node.js**
, for the `npx` installer below and for the artifact skills' editors (Node 20+, the dashboard and Mo
installer below and for the artifact skills' editors (Node 20+, the dashboard and Motion Node 22+).
